title: Response
description: One response line: exactly one per request (except `cancel`, which has none).

result.description: Present when `ok` is true. `OpResult` for every op but `hello`, which returns `HelloResult`.

message.description: For people and agents; do not parse.

reason.description:
With `unsupported`: why the file is left as it is, one sentence meant to be shown to
people as it is (or translated). Absent when there is nothing to say beyond `message`.

ErrorCode.description: Error codes from `engine/PROTOCOL.md`. The set is closed: clients switch on it.

oneOf.description: The input format, or this combination of input and op, is not handled by the engine.
The input file (or the folder of the output) does not exist.
The input could not be decoded (corrupt or truncated file).
Reading or writing a file failed.
The result would not be smaller than the input; nothing was written.
The request or its params are malformed or out of range.
The request was cancelled before it finished; nothing was written.
A bug in the engine (a caught panic, an impossible state).
